requirementSummary: When a Cooling Package is entered and calculations run, the system must populate the Cooling Circuits, compute the sum of all Circuit Heights, and display that total in the DX Coil Height field; the total must be recomputed and the DX Coil Height field updated whenever a user edits any Circuit Height.
businessRules: Upon entry of a Cooling Package and execution of calculations, the system shall populate the list of Cooling Circuits.
After the Cooling Circuits are populated, the DX Coil Height field shall be set to the sum of the Height values of all Cooling Circuits.
If a user modifies the Height of any Cooling Circuit, the system shall recompute the sum of all Circuit Heights and update the DX Coil Height field accordingly.
developerConsiderations: Implement event listeners on Circuit Height fields to trigger recalculation of the DX Coil Height.
Ensure the sum calculation runs after the Cooling Circuits are initially populated.
Update the DX Coil Height field in the DX Coil Information section dynamically.
ambiguities: What unit of measurement should be used for Circuit Height and DX Coil Height (e.g., inches, feet, meters)?
What rounding behavior should be applied to the summed DX Coil Height (e.g., round to nearest tenth, two decimals, or no rounding)?
How should the system handle cases where no Cooling Circuits are present (e.g., set DX Coil Height to zero or leave blank)?
Are there any validation limits on individual Circuit Height values (e.g., minimum or maximum allowed)?
